meta.name: work-with-pr
meta.description: Full PR lifecycle in a fresh task-owned git worktree: implement via the ulw-loop skill with mandatory evidence-bound manual QA → reviewer-readable English PR → verification loop (CI + Cubic, where Cubic is skipped only when its quota is exhausted) → merge by default → worktree cleanup. Decomposes one task into the smallest atomic, independently-mergeable PRs and builds the independent ones concurrently via one worktree per PR driven by parallel subagents or a team. Unbounded loop: any failing gate sends you back to fix-and-re-QA inside that PR's worktree. Use whenever implementation work needs to land as a PR. Triggers: 'create a PR', 'implement and PR', 'work on this and make a PR', 'implement issue', 'land this as a PR', 'split into atomic PRs', 'parallel PRs', 'work-with-pr', 'PR workflow', 'implement end to end', even when user just says 'implement X' if the context implies PR delivery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将实现任务自动拆分为可合并的PR并完成全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将开发任务拆成多个独立PR并自动走完提交流程
copy.tagline_en: Automate full PR lifecycle from task decomposition to merge
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to split development tasks into independent PRs and automate the submission process

howto.what: Claude 会为每个任务创建独立的 git 工作区，将任务拆成多个小 PR，逐个实现、测试、创建英文 PR、通过 CI 和 Cubic 审查后自动合并，最后清理工作区。
howto.when: 当你要求创建 PR、实现并提交 PR、处理 issue、拆分原子 PR、并行 PR 或说“实现 X”且上下文暗示需要 PR 时触发。

say.text: 帮我实现这个功能并创建一个 PR。
say.note: Claude 会拆分任务、创建多个小 PR 并逐步完成。

say.text: 把这个 issue 拆成几个原子 PR 并行开发。
say.note: Claude 会分析依赖，并行构建独立 PR。

say.text: 为这个改动创建 PR 并合并。
say.note: Claude 会走完整流程：实现、测试、PR、审查、合并。

howto.what_en: Claude creates isolated git worktrees per task, decomposes the task into atomic PRs, implements each with evidence-bound manual QA, creates reviewer-readable English PRs, runs CI and Cubic verification loops, auto-merges by default, and cleans up worktrees.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a PR, implement and PR, work on an issue, split into atomic PRs, parallel PRs, or say 'implement X' with PR context.

say_en.text: Implement this feature and create a PR.
Split this issue into atomic PRs and develop them in parallel.
say_en.note: Claude will analyze dependencies and build independent PRs concurrently.

say_en.text: Create a PR for this change and merge it.
say_en.note: Claude will go through the full lifecycle: implement, test, PR, review, merge.
